_meta.purpose: Information-only comparison of how India (FSSAI), the EU and the US treat an additive. Shown only when the user asks for it. It never changes a verdict, a score or a concern level: those use FSSAI rules only (D-086).
rules: Only rows checked against the regulation text go in. A jurisdiction that has not been checked is left out and shown as 'not yet checked'.
status is one of the enum values below; display text is built from status_text, never written per row, so every row passes the D-042 wording lint.
A 'limit depends on the food type' status is used when the regulation sets different limits per food category; the product's category is not known yet, so no single number is quoted.

status_text.permitted_gmp: Permitted in all food types, in the amount needed (GMP)
status_text.permitted_with_limits: Permitted, with a limit that depends on the food type
status_text.permitted_with_warning: Permitted, but the pack must carry a warning: "{warning}"
status_text.not_permitted: Not permitted as a food additive
status_text.not_permitted_since: Not permitted as a food additive since {since}
status_text.revoked: Permission withdrawn on {since}; must be out of food by {deadline}
